sections.text:
{
  "candidate_sha256": "29f8a7950e9b92d639e37746c5dc7a04be8f96411a25e3d6ccc00a37a9965126",
  "findings": [
    {
      "area": "drive FQN canon",
      "evidence": "packages/drive/src/DriveContext.php:40-65 implements Vaulter\\Contracts\\Drive\\DriveHandle with storage()/panel(); packages/core/src/Contracts/Drive/DriveHandle.php:24-26 requires model(): Drive and profile(): Profile; packages/drive/src/StorageManager.php:95 dispatches StorageCreated; packages/drive/src/DriveProvisioner.php:95 dispatches DriveCreated; packages/drive/src/Activity/RecordsDriveActivity.php:48 listens only for DriveCreated; UPGRADE.md:11-12 claims the old names are gone; both trees are present under packages/drive/src/{Actions,Data,Events,Exceptions,Http,Support/Uploads} and the new domain directories.",
      "file": "packages/drive/src/DriveContext.php",
      "line": 40,
      "risk_class": "local",
      "scenario": "Loading Vaulter\\Drive\\DriveContext is a fatal error: it implements Vaulter\\Contracts\\Drive\\DriveHandle but still declares storage(): Drive and panel(): string and does not declare the required model(): Drive or profile(): Profile. The 03 §4 renames were copied into the new namespaces and the old files were left autoloadable (DriveContext beside DriveHandle, StorageManager beside DriveProvisioner, Actions\\CreateFolderAction beside Actions\\Nodes\\CreateFolderAction, Events\\StorageCreated beside Events\\Drives\\DriveCreated, and the same fork for the other Actions, Data, Events, Exceptions, Http requests/resources/controllers, and Support\\Uploads\\StagedUpload/MagicByteSniffer). The required code-guidance scan is therefore not empty, and UPGRADE.md states that those old names have no aliases. Resolving the leftover StorageManager still dispatches StorageCreated from provision(), while the live DriveProvisioner path dispatches DriveCreated and RecordsDriveActivity/RecordsDriveOutbox listen only for DriveCreated, so that leftover provisioner writes neither an activity row nor an outbox row. In-repo callers still import the old types, including load/app/Console/PrepareMemoryFixturesCommand.php.",
      "severity": "blocker"
    },
    {
      "area": "drive domain event catalog",
      "evidence": "docs/reference/events.md:90-107 lists StorageCreated and NodeCreated under Vaulter\\Drive\\Events and says StorageCreated fires when Vaulter::for() get-or-creates a drive; docs/ru/reference/events.md:96-107 repeats that; packages/drive/src/DriveProvisioner.php:95 dispatches DriveCreated; packages/drive/src/Actions/Nodes/CreateFolderAction.php:9 and :68 dispatch FolderCreated.",
      "file": "docs/reference/events.md",
      "line": 96,
      "risk_class": "local",
      "scenario": "A host that follows the drive event reference and listens for Vaulter\\Drive\\Events\\StorageCreated or NodeCreated never sees Vaulter::for() provisioning or folder creation. Those live paths dispatch Vaulter\\Drive\\Events\\Drives\\DriveCreated and Vaulter\\Drive\\Events\\Nodes\\FolderCreated. The Russian reference repeats the same old names, so both catalogs subscribe consumers to the leftover event classes.",
      "severity": "major"
    },
    {
      "area": "DriveHandle profile contract",
      "evidence": "docs/guide/drive.md:87-89 annotates $drive->profile() as string; docs/ru/guide/drive.md:71 does the same; packages/core/src/Contracts/Drive/DriveHandle.php:26 and packages/drive/src/DriveHandle.php:64-67 return Profile from ProfileRegistry::get(); packages/core/src/Profiles/Profile.php:8-64 has getId() and no __toString; UPGRADE.md:69-74 documents the Profile return.",
      "file": "docs/guide/drive.md",
      "line": 89,
      "risk_class": "local",
      "scenario": "A caller who follows the drive guide treats $drive->profile() as a string. The core contract and DriveHandle::profile() return Vaulter\\Profiles\\Profile, which exposes getId() and has no __toString. Passing that value to a string parameter or interpolating it under the package's strict types raises TypeError. The Russian drive guide has the same annotation, while UPGRADE.md tells callers to use profile()->getId().",
      "severity": "major"
    },
    {
      "area": "drive REST reference names",
      "evidence": "docs/reference/rest-api.md:68-70; packages/drive/routes/drive.php:38 registers ShowDriveController::class; packages/drive/src/Http/Controllers/Drives/ShowDriveController.php:55 is __invoke and :68 returns DriveResource::make; no show method exists on that class.",
      "file": "docs/reference/rest-api.md",
      "line": 68,
      "risk_class": "local",
      "scenario": "The REST reference says GET storages/{storage} is ShowDriveController::show and the body is StorageResource. ShowDriveController has no show method; the route registers the invokable class and the only action is __invoke, which returns DriveResource. JSON keys are unchanged, but the documented action and resource class are the pre-rename names.",
      "severity": "minor"
    }
  ],
  "reviewer": "grok/grok-4.7/500000",
  "schema_version": "review-verdict/v1",
  "verdict": "FINDINGS"
}
